newsitem.title: INDIA: Bangladesh PM hopes to sign water pact with India.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh PM hopes to sign water pact with India.

text.p: Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina said on Wednesday that she hoped to reach agreement with India on the sharing of water from the Ganges river during bilateral talks this week. * Hasina was asked by reporters after a welcome ceremony at India's presidential palace if she expected to reach agreement with New Delhi by the end of her three-day visit on Thursday. "I am hopeful," she said.
Hasina, who assumed power in June following general elections, said she could give any details about a possible water-sharing agreement until talks were over.
"Discussions are going on. So I think after everything is settled, then we can say," she said.
The two sides were expected to sign an agreement on Thursday.

Hasina was scheduled to meet President Shankar Dayal Sharma, Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda and Foreign Minister Inder Kumar Gujral on Wednesday. The proposed water-sharing pact is considered a key test of Hasina's leadership.
